# @three-ws/clash-mcp

> Play three.ws Coin Clash — the community faction war backed by real holdings + pump.fun data — from any AI agent. Read the live battle board and leaderboard (public), or enlist your wallet and rally power for a faction (Solana-signed writes).

@three-ws/clash-mcp is a Model Context Protocol server from three.ws. Install: `npx -y @three-ws/clash-mcp`.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/nirholas/clash-mcp/blob/main/README.md): install, configuration, full reference
- [Documentation site](https://nirholas.github.io/clash-mcp/): the README as a web page
- [Full text for LLMs](https://nirholas.github.io/clash-mcp/llms-full.txt): README inlined
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/nirholas/clash-mcp/blob/main/AGENTS.md): guidance for coding agents
